root_cause.text: Double decrement of `s_dirtyclusters_counter` in the error path of ext4 block allocation because `ext4_mb_mark_diskspace_used()` decrements the counter after a metadata dirty failure and then `ext4_mb_new_blocks()` decrements it again when `ar->len` is zero.

The patch removes the decrement from `ext4_mb_mark_diskspace_used()` and consolidates it into a single decrement in `ext4_mb_new_blocks()`.
